lines.en: I cross the jungle's haze
My legs snap vines underfoot
I walk on rotting soil
My claws sink into the mud
I pass through a jungle clearing
My tail sweeps the leaves aside
My head stays low
I shift out of the tree shadows
I turn toward you slowly
I push my head into the vines
My toe claws flip the leaf litter
I walk around a boulder
I stop under a big tree
My jaw works slowly
I lift my head to sniff
My tail swings lightly
I wait for the heat to ease
I have no intention of lying down
There is mud on my scales
I slant my snout aside
My foreclaws scrape the ground
I gnaw an old bone
My breathing comes deep
I lower my body slowly
You have entered my stretch of jungle
I open my mouth to show teeth
You stand rather too straight
You do not belong in these trees
A rumble rolls in my throat
My tail has stopped
You are not thinking of running
I lift a foreclaw
I push off and give half a step
I shake the blood off
A mark stays on my ribs
My ribs go numb from the blow.
I growl my way back
My legs still brace the ground
This is no time to back off
I glare at you and pant
You drop meat on the ground
I bring my snout in to sniff

lines.zh: 我的头骨很厚，经得起撞。
lines.en: My skull is thick enough to take a hit.
This little is not enough
The meat pouch at your belt sways.
Throw it further off
I step two paces that way
The meat smells fresh
I finish and keep watching your hands
You crack against my thigh
You are knocked aside
My ribs are hard as timber
I snap at the air
You had better back off
I sidestep out of the way
I brake to a stop

lines.zh: 我一侧身，肩膀撞开挡路的东西。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and shove aside whatever blocks me.
There are others of my kind here
I have her scent
I leave claw marks as a sign
She is smaller than I am
We hold this ground together
I rarely call out
She walks behind me
That can wait for later
She answers with a call
We stop by the roots
I grip it in my teeth
This bone is not fresh
I bite it clean in two
I shake my head and drop it
I walk off over it
I carry it under the tree
This does not suit my appetite
I pick the meat from the bone
You walked into my ground
My head is already up
All my teeth show
This stretch of jungle is mine
You are within biting range
I have already started forward
I have my eyes on your neck
I growl as I close

lines.zh: 你脚下没有再退的地方
lines.en: There is no room left behind you
I stretch my jaws wide
I know this pounce well
I follow along your footprints
You duck behind a tree to the left
I come around the trunk after you

lines.zh: 我的脚步在落叶上很响
lines.en: My steps are loud on the leaves
You are behind the vines
I lower my head to your prints
No hurry, I press slowly
My shadow lies over yours
I wait for you to turn
I lower my head to shoulder height
My breathing is right behind you
I know these vines
Your foot is caught in a vine

lines.zh: 你踩倒的蕨叶还没直起来。
lines.en: The ferns you crushed haven't straightened yet.

lines.zh: 你藏在叶子里我看得见
lines.en: I can see you in the leaves
My teeth set into your shoulder
My claw lands on your back
I butt you with my skull
I knock you to the ground
My foreclaw pins you
My teeth tear your clothes
That bite went deep
I fling you clear
I shake my head and tear
I hit once and pull back
You fall back and I press on
I bite and do not let go
That bite went wide
I turn my head and bite
My foreclaw catches your knee

lines.zh: 我的厚头骨先顶开藤蔓。
lines.en: My thick skull pushes the vines aside first.
A line of claws joins the hot soil
My shadow falls across the vines
I test the air
My head comes out of the treeline
I push the leaves aside
I take my place in the clearing
A wild smell joins the air
I shake the mud off my back
I slide down the muddy bank
My tail parts the grass first
I halt by the water
I turn my skull your way
I crush a patch of rotting soil
My low roar arrives first
Fire singes the scales on my back
I land and roll half over
Water fills my throat and I thrash
The blast throws me into the vines
The arrow shaft quivers with my breath.
Magic leaves my jaw numb
There is less game in this jungle
Lightning runs along my spine
I fall with my mouth still open
